provenance.generated_with: Code written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic) under the team's direction; data computed by this code from the listed sources.

method_note: P-S light (STANDARDS 10.15). Circular orbit, Sun as a point; 72 year fractions x 144 hour angles. Obliquity from config/light.json: Earth 23.44 and Mars 25.19 (NSSDC, to the orbit plane); Moon 1.54 (lunar equator to the ecliptic, Cassini's second law; NSSDC 6.68 is not used). noon_sun_max = 90 - max(0, |lat| - eps) and noon_sun_min = 90 - (|lat| + eps) are closed forms. sun_time_pct = share of samples with elevation > 0; grazing_pct = share with 0 < elevation < 10 deg; shares are over all 10368 samples, and samples exactly at 0 deg count as not sunlit. local_horizon (Moon targets with a LOLA 5 m surface DEM only; toterr files are uncertainty, not elevation): 36 azimuths every 10 deg, observer 2 m above the DEM centre, horizon = max over rays of atan((z(d) - d^2/(2R) - (z0 + 2)) / d) up to the nearest valid edge (reach). sun_time_relief_pct = share of samples with elevation > the horizon at the nearest azimuth. Label: near horizon only (within <reach> km); far mountains not included.
